subject: Approval: joining incentive waiver for Principal ModelOps candidate (S. Marquez)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: joining incentive waiver for Principal ModelOps candidate (S. Marquez)

Hi Laura and Karthik —

Following up from the hiring sync: we've got a strong candidate for the Principal ModelOps role, Sofia Marquez (referred via Barnaby). She's currently fielding an external counter from QuantumEdge that materially exceeds our standard band. Recruiter is asking if we can offer a one-time joining incentive + an early equity refresh to close.

Summary:
- Base band (grade 8): $185k-$215k — we have committed $210k in base.
- Candidate expectation: $220k base or equivalent total comp at target.
- Proposed Redwood offer (internal ask): $210k base + $35k one-time cash joining incentive (out-of-band) + 5k RSUs immediate refresh (vesting schedule to preserve retention).
- Rationale: unique infra + MLOps experience, immediate impact on infra reliability and kernel selection roadmap, strong retention risk due to active counteroffer.

Attachments: offer_summary_S_Marquez.pdf (detailed comps + role notes), comp_bands_snapshot_Q3_2027.xlsx, reference_notes_S_Marquez.txt

Ask: approval to proceed with the proposed joining incentive (one-time cash $35k) and an out-of-cycle equity refresh (5k RSUs) for this candidate. If approved, we'll route offer to candidate with recruiting and legal to finalize DocuSign.

Timing: recruiter asks for confirmation by Tue 8/3 COB to avoid losing candidate.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Model Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: joining incentive waiver for Principal ModelOps candidate (S. Marquez)

Marcus —

Thanks for the writeup. A few quick clarifying asks before I can sign off:
1) Please enumerate any precedents in the last 12 months where we approved cash incentives > $25k for senior individual contributors and outcomes (retention / performance).
2) Who is the budget owner for this role and is there headcount capacity in the FY27 hiring plan? If this is incremental, we need an explicit headcount exception.
3) Propose a retention clawback schedule for the cash incentive (e.g., prorated over 18 months) and confirm RSU tranche timing.
4) Legal / Tax implications for paying a large one-time cash incentive to a candidate outside the US (candidate is US-based but has EU tax residency historically) — please coordinate with Monica.

I am tentatively supportive of flexibility given the candidate profile and urgency, but need the above to justify exceeding the band.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Talent & Org Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: joining incentive waiver for Principal ModelOps candidate (S. Marquez)

Laura / Marcus —

Quick answers:
- Precedents: two approvals in last 12 months for mission-critical IC hires: $30k cash (SRE hire, 2027-03) and $28k cash (Inference Engineer, 2026-11), both with 18-month prorated clawbacks; both retained beyond 18 months. I'll pull the req IDs and attach.
- Budget/headcount: This req falls under FY27 headcount for Platform; budget owner (me) confirms available headcount and capacity. No additional headcount needed.
- Clawback proposal: prorated over 18 months, 100% repayable if voluntary departure within 6 months, 50% for 6–12 months, 25% for 12–18 months.
- RSU timing: 5k RSUs as a refresh that vests on the standard schedule starting at 6 months (first vest at 12 months) — proposal to minimize immediate dilution and tie to impact.
- Tax/legal: Monica has visibility; Monica, can you confirm any cross-border withholding concerns for Sofia?

Recommendation: approve up to $35k one-time cash joining incentive + 5k RSU refresh with the clawback schedule above, contingent on final legal sign-off.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Engineering
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Marquez <sofia.marquez@gmail.com>, Nick Hall <nick@barnabyrecruit.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: Principal ModelOps — Redwood Inference (finalized)

Sofia —

Great to speak earlier. We're excited about the possibility of you joining Redwood as Principal, Model Operations. Per internal approvals, here's the offer summary we're prepared to send: 

- Title: Principal, Model Operations
- Base salary: $210,000 (annual)
- One-time joining incentive: $35,000 (gross cash), subject to 18-month prorated clawback as discussed (100% within 6 months, 50% 6–12 months, 25% 12–18 months).
- Equity: standard grant + 5,000 RSU refresh (subject to standard grant docs; refresh vests starting at 6 months).
- Benefits and other standard Redwood perks to be included in DocuSign packet.

We need a response to this offer by end of day Friday 8/6 to proceed. We will route the official offer package through DocuSign once you confirm acceptance in principle.

If you have any immediate questions, reply here or reach out to Nick.

Thanks —
Marcus
Director, Model Operations, Redwood Inference
